# ContextTax

Measures the context-window tax an MCP server/tool imposes on an agent — schema bloat and response bloat, across the full token lifecycle — with ground-truth accuracy.

## Why

A modern agent loads every tool definition into its context before the user says a word. A single large MCP server can cost tens of thousands of tokens just to declare its tools; a stack of servers can burn 100-200K tokens up front. Then each tool response dumps more tokens into the window. ContextTax measures the whole lifecycle: schema load, call overhead, response tokens, and how they amortize across a multi-turn session.

## Usage

  contexttax measure --tools <tools.json> [--estimate]
  contexttax session --transcript <session.json> --tools <tools.json> [--estimate]

Ground-truth counts use the Anthropic count_tokens endpoint (funded API account). The keyless --estimate mode approximates offline with an o200k_base tokenizer.
